description: Source code for a Python script that acts as an adapter for the Ruff linter, providing command-line interface, lint message processing, and auto-fix capabilities.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration for severity levels of lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Dataclass representing a lint message with details such as path, line, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: as_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to POSIX forward slash paths if on Windows.

methods.name: _run_command
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command with optional input, timeout, and error checking.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Runs a command with retries and timeout, handling TimeoutExpired exceptions.

methods.name: add_default_options
methods.description: Adds common command-line arguments to an argparse parser.

methods.name: explain_rule
methods.description: Retrieves and formats an explanation for a specific lint rule code using Ruff.

methods.name: get_issue_severity
methods.description: Determines the severity level of a lint issue based on its code prefix.

methods.name: format_lint_message
methods.description: Formats a lint message string with optional rule explanation and disable instructions.

methods.name: check_files
methods.description: Runs Ruff on a list of files, returning lint messages with severity and details.

methods.name: check_file_for_fixes
methods.description: Runs Ruff to auto-fix issues in a file and returns the diff as a lint message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, parsing arguments, running checks, and handling fixes.
